def priority(item):
        for job_id in groups[item]:
            status, job, _ = drain_job(ROOT, config, queue, job_id)
            if (status == 'run' and job and job.get('item') == item

evidence.reason: The drain sorts items with priority(), and line 853 calls pending(job_id) in the sort key without any exception guard. If pending() raises on a malformed result artifact, sorted() fails before line 856 calls drain_items(), so unrelated queued items are never dispatched. The same unguarded pending call appears during item processing at line 888. Excluding only the malformed-result job while preserving missing-vs-terminal behavior is a routine correctness fix.
